authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: The entire drinking progressive is drink + remain/progressive + present copula. Turner pibati supplies pī-/pīv-, *rahati the rah-/r- auxiliary, and ākṣeti the hai/che copula family. Fused spellings are retained and all three lexical constituents are represented.

proposals.evidence: The whole phrase consists of the drink verb, with its ordinary regional inflection, and the present copula hai/he. Turner pibati and ākṣeti provide those two families; the inflection is not treated as a separate derivational etymon.

proposals.evidence: The whole phrase is the sūt-/hūt- asleep stem plus the present copula. Turner supta explicitly supplies Old Marwari sūto and Old Gujarati sūtaü, separately from the svapati present stem; ākṣeti supplies hai/che. The western h forms are compared with that asleep family, without rewriting the source phonetics.
